archetype: ORGANIC & PERFORMANCE PRO (Local Commerce + Fintech Trust)

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.system: 8px spacing system (p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12)
spacing_and_layout.customer_app: Mobile-first width constraint max-w-md mx-auto bg-white min-h-screen shadow-xl sm:my-4 sm:rounded-3xl sm:overflow-hidden sm:border sm:border-slate-200
spacing_and_layout.merchant_portal: Responsive desktop layout with sticky sidebar navigation, top header KPI strip, fluid grid widgets (3-4 cols)
spacing_and_layout.admin_panel: High density data grid layout, sticky command header, filters, data table with pagination, slide-out drawer details

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for resting cards, shadow-md for hover states, shadow-lg for floating modals & floating bottom navs
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/60 for fixed top bars
visual_enhancers.states: Every action button and card MUST include distinct loading (spinners/skeletons), success toast, error banner, empty states with clear graphics, and disabled states with opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed

customer.description: Mobile-first local commerce app experience with bottom navigation bar (Home, Explore, Orders, Wallet, Profile)
key_views: Splash/Auth (OTP Login with Indian phone number format +91)
Home Feed (Location selector top bar, Banner Carousel, Category grid: Produce, Grocery, Agri, Services, Classifieds, Ads)
Store & Product Detail with add to cart & dynamic local pricing
Cart & Multi-step Checkout with address selector and payment gateway
Sell/List Something wizard (Store registration, Agri selling, Services, Classifieds)

merchant.description: Desktop & tablet seller dashboard for shopkeepers, service providers, and agricultural vendors
key_views: KPI Dashboard (Today's Sales, Orders, Settled Amount, Active Ads)
Order Management (Real-time status transition: New, Accepted, Packed, Out for Delivery, Completed)
Product/Inventory Catalog Manager with stock toggle & price update
Wallet, Settlement & Withdrawal portal with IFSC bank account details

admin.description: System administration panel for platform moderation, merchant approvals, financial settlements, and analytics
key_views: Global Platform Dashboard (GMV, Active Users, Total Stores, Pending Approvals)
Withdrawal Request Approvals with audit trail
System Configuration, Discount/Offer engine, Audit Logs

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements and key text containers MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='cart-item-count')
Use Lucide-React icons strictly for clean consistency
Use Sonner toast notifications for feedback
Ensure total accessibility and zero transparent background cutoffs on dropdowns/popovers
No cheap gradients; rely on crisp borders, deep green #0F4C3A accents, and soft slate gray card backgrounds
